title: preCICE tutorials system tests: components.yaml
description: The components (e.g., adapters, language bindings) that can be used by the cases of the tutorials, together with the parameters that their Docker image accepts.

template.description: Path to the Docker Compose service template of this component, relative to the tests directory.

build_timeout.description: Timeout for building the Docker image of this component, in seconds.

build_arguments.description: The build arguments of the Docker image of this component, by name.

description.description: Short description of the build argument.

repository.description: Repository that a _REF build argument refers to.

default.description: Default value. Build arguments without a default value are required.

value_options.description: The values that are accepted. If not specified, all values are accepted.
